composition.camera_angle: eye level slightly below standing height, about 30 degrees oblique to the arch's long axis so the curve and one open end both read
focal_hierarchy: soft bright sheen band along the crown of the fold
gradient into cooler grey legs with grain following the bend
thin contact shadows where the legs meet the concrete
luminous ceiling plane and quiet white walls
composition.layout: arch spans the central two-thirds just below the horizontal midline; glowing ceiling band across the top edge; concrete floor plane fills the lower third

concept_thesis: The most economical gesture in the reference room, a single sheet of brushed stainless steel bent once into a seat, is enlarged past any use and isolated under shadowless light. It still looks almost sittable, but it is too long, too singular and too carefully placed to serve anyone, so commerce drains out and only the fold remains: a sculpture whose subject is how diffuse light travels around one bend in steel.

lighting.environment: empty room under a backlit frosted ceiling grid glowing as one even plane, matte warm off-white walls with soft falloff to the floor, troweled grey concrete floor with a faint soft reflection; reflections blurred, never legible

key.direction: directly overhead from the full ceiling plane, broad and even

lighting.setup: sourceless luminous ceiling: backlit diffuser grid acting as one large even overhead softbox, high-key

materials.finish: linear brushed satin stainless, grain following the bend
imperfections: faint longitudinal grain variation along the sheet
slightly softer burnished patch on the crown
materials.role: the single bent-sheet arch sculpture, 8 to 15 mm thick, with fine bright lines on the cut edges

semantic_constraints.constraint: no people, figures, body parts or reflections of people
exactly one steel object, a single continuous bent sheet
empty matte white room with grey concrete floor
thin contact shadows ground the arch on the floor
no text, logos, signage or watermark
high-key compressed value range with no deep shadows
reads as sculpture, not furniture: no other furniture, props or products
floor seams or wall height give a clear metre scale

subject.description: one low bent brushed stainless steel arch sculpture alone on concrete under a luminous ceiling, formed from a single continuous sheet folded once through a wide smooth radius into a long low inverted-U several metres long and roughly knee to waist high, centred in an otherwise empty matte white room

visual_hypothesis: If one continuous brushed-steel sheet bent through a single wide radius (a low inverted-U, roughly knee to waist height and several metres long) stands alone on grey concrete in an empty matte white room lit only by a luminous ceiling, then the curvature will carry an unbroken sheen gradient from a soft bright band on the crown to cooler mid-grey legs, with grain following the bend. That gradient is the image. Test: the critic sees brushed grain and a stretched soft highlight rather than mirror reflections or flat paint, a thin contact shadow under each leg, a high-key compressed value range, and nothing that reads as a cafe, shop, product shot or person.
